title: 長文読解
subtitle: 読むこと｜対話文・説明文・スピーチ・グラフ・資料の読み取り
subject: english

stimuli.content:
Last spring, a new teacher from Singapore, Mr. Lee, came to our school. On his first day, he got lost on his way from the station. When I heard about it, I wanted to help foreign students and teachers in our city.

So my friends and I decided to make a map of our town. We walked around the town and took notes about shops, parks, and the hospital. We finished it after two weeks. The map was written in Japanese and English.

We gave the map to Mr. Lee. He smiled and said, "This is very useful. Thank you!" Now the map is in the city hall, and many people use it.

Through this project, I learned that small actions can help people. I want to do more things for people in my town.
stimuli.title: 次の英文は、中学生の Sora が書いたものである。

stimuli.content: Mr. Smith: Look at this graph. We asked 200 students in our school, "How often do you eat breakfast?" Sixty-two percent of the students eat breakfast every day. But eight percent never eat breakfast. Breakfast is important because it gives us energy for the morning. So I want you to get up a little earlier and eat breakfast.
